      Keyboard shortcuts

      Click a field, then press a key with ⌘, ⌥, ⌃ or ⇧. Esc cancels. If a combination shows nothing when you press it, Safari or macOS keeps it for itself (⌘⌥← / ⌘⌥→ switch Safari's tabs), so pick another.
